Glossary
The glossary provides short, stable definitions for recurring terms used through

Term	Definition (plain text)
Latency	The delay between a request and the first meaningful response.
Throughput	The amount of work completed per unit of time (e.g., requests per second).
Availability	The fraction of time a system is functioning and accessible as intended.
JSON	A text-based data format using braces, brackets, keys, and values; strict syntax matters.
API	An interface that allows software components to communicate via defined requests and responses.
BPM	Beats per minute; a common unit for musical tempo.
Time signature (e.g., 3/4)	A notation that groups beats into repeating patterns, independent of tempo.
Hohmann transfer	A fuel-efficient orbital maneuver concept that changes between two circular orbits.
